iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max have brought quite a few changes to the main camera and the iOS camera app, and photographer Austin Mann happens to have just released a comprehensive review detailing all the new features.

Austin Mann publishes in-depth review of iPhone 18 Pro camera upgrades

Every year, photographer Austin Mann releases an in-depth review of the new iPhone camera features, and of course it comes with plenty of stunning photos.

Mann's iPhone 18 Pro camera review was published today, and I highly recommend everyone take a look—both an overview of the new features and photo samples are included.

Speaking about the newly added variable aperture feature, Mann said:

He shared several stunning photos of the Colorado night sky taken with the iPhone 18 Pro's new wider aperture.

Speaking about the brand-new Pro controls exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, what got Mann most excited was manual focus:

Regarding Photographic Styles 3, Tyler Stalman and other reviewers have mentioned it can be used to create film-like photos. Mann agrees, and offers the following tips for getting the best film effect:

  • "Shoot a bit darker, say -1.0, and open the aperture all the way to f/1.48. Using manual focus, the image will be slightly softer (that's OK!)."
  • "Shoot in HEIF format so you can use Photographic Styles."
  • "Then in post, move the dot on the D-Pad to the bottom right corner to reduce tone-mapping (that HDR look), compress the shadows and also push the highlights."
  • "You can dial down the film effect to reduce halo effect, which can sometimes be too strong."

You can watch Austin Mann's video review below.

Mann's full review also covers features like Focus Tracking, Apple Reference Image, and 4K time-lapse photography.

Check out Austin Mann's full iPhone 18 Pro camera review here.
